t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Ŋa I maa seri faa kɛ, O ŋa Γalai, a gɛɛ yà gbɛtɛ́ ŋa kɔlɔŋ ŋà I fɛli. Ŋa faa ma kpɔnɔ ŋi ŋa fii kpɛɛ su da I wala laa da kolo laa da I tɔɔ laai, Γala da kpɔni fe na fɛɛ nɔ yâ tɔnɔ, I kpɔŋ maai kukula mɛni kpulu su, I kɛtɛi I kpiŋ kponôi.
